backdrop_method: Reference-guided edit of the storyboard candidate. Retain the waterfall and painted perimeter, replace the right-side baked tunnel with solid tree art, and clear the central field. Output cropped to 1280×720 and encoded as an opaque JPEG. The woodland exit uses KRT_48 as a sand strip with authored tree layers in front of the backdrop.
portrait_method: Independent RGBA crops of the supplied storyboard portrait sheets. Manager concerned reuses briefing, Leader reassuring reuses steady. The asset contract leaves the existing dialogue keys in place.
original_vectors: Terrain and UI atlases, projectile and effect shapes, and mission-node backplate were authored for this project and reference only the storyboard grammar.
actor_badges: C07 Scout, W27 Patrolman, E01 rust and Logistics Post Ready composites.
woodland_exit: Original vector art for the approved T01 endpoint revision. SVGs are layered for the trail runout, far trees and foreground trees. Forest and earth tones follow the approved stage backdrop.
